svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "Too many offspring."], [1, "A fig tree drops thousands of seeds."], [4.5, "Resources are limited: competition."], [8, "Only a handful survive to become trees."]]
svg.title: Overproduction of offspring
svg.desc: A fig tree producing thousands of seeds, competition for limited light, water and minerals, and only a handful of seedlings surviving to adulthood.
svg.text: Too many offspring: the struggle for survival

g.data-info: Populations produce more offspring than the environment can support: a fig tree makes thousands of seeds; only a handful become trees.
Food, water, nesting sites, territory, light and minerals limit the carrying capacity, so individuals compete.

g.text: limited light, water, minerals, space → competition

g.data-info: Only some survive to reproduce: those best adapted are more likely to.

g.text: thousands of seeds → only a handful survive to reproduce
